## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused changes that address it.

## Outcome

Describe the resulting behavior, including before/after behavior when useful.

## Validation

List checks actually performed, their results, and evidence for mandatory pre-merge acceptance. Report failures, skipped checks, and unperformed checks with reasons. Do not claim success without evidence.

Record genuinely required post-merge verification separately as pending, or state "None." Distinguish optional validation from mandatory checks.

## Related issues

Link the source Issue and any related Issues. Use a closing reference (for example, "Closes #123") only when this PR fully implements the Issue. State any intentionally partial scope explicitly.
